description: Notes in a chat whose model runs on another host (an agent run through the mesh): what went wrong getting it there and back.

messages.pi_too_big: pi's session is too big to carry to the host that runs this model, or couldn't be read
messages.unreachable: couldn't reach the host that runs this model ({$host}): {$why}
messages.pi_not_kept: pi's session couldn't be kept on this host as it was written
messages.connection_gone: the connection to the host that runs this model is gone
messages.tools_missing: {$tools} didn't reach {$host}, which runs this model: it can't use them in this conversation, and may make up what they'd return
messages.pi_not_written: pi's session couldn't be written here
